page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no margin notes. Running head at top: "Jo. MORINO", page number 243 at top right. Gathering signature "M 2" and catchword "an" at the foot.

main_text.p: tavi. Astronomi autem tui lapsum non esse ex aliis, quæ affers, exemplis manifestum est. Refers in Ephemeride Persico, 21. diem Martii anni Christi 1622, in octavum diem Gemadi, prioris anni Hegirae 1031. adnotatum fuisse: idem brevissime quod in priori exemplo præstitemus. Anni 1030 completi superant 993 completos, annis 137, defectus anni lunaris à solari 16 d. 21 h. 1 m. ducatur in 37, emergent 402 dies, quibus junge 207, residuum superius adnotatum, dies fient 609; hoc est annus solaris & 244 d. quæ juncta annis 29, efficient anni 30, & 244 dies, quo annorum & dierum numero anni Hegirae 1030 completi superant numerum annorum solarium ejusdem Hegirae. Demantur igitur à 1030, anni 30, restabunt mille anni solares: ab his iterum deme dies 244, residui erunt 999 anni, dies 121, prorsus æquales 1030 annis Hegirae completis. Anni autem 999 solares finiti sunt die 15. Julii an. 1621, duravit Hegirae annus præterea diebus 121; finiit ergo die Nov. 13, ac proinde

page.notes: Doubtful: a bracket-like sign stands before "Nov." in "die Nov. 13"; it is not transcribed. Spellings kept as printed: "qvod" and "æqvales" were printed with v, and "dies121" and "1031" have no space in the print. The catchword "an" sits at the foot right. The dark vertical band on the right is the scanner edge and is not transcribed.
